title: A modifier whole scopes over the next head only
summary: Test whether a candidate modifier applies to the immediately following head, rather than the whole field or previous head. Repeated and interrupted modifier frames provide a quantitative scope discriminator.

design.mechanism: The modifier has local forward scope over one head.
design.unit: modifier-plus-head sequence with one or more neighboring heads
design.contrast: next-head compatibility versus prior-head and whole-field alternatives
design.prediction: At least 70% of held modifier occurrences select the next head, with next-head excess >=20 points over prior-head controls.
design.scope: cached modifier-bearing fields; feasibility unknown until head tags are independently assigned
design.countermodel: Modifier scope is global or backward; next-head preference disappears in interrupted sequences.
design.binding: independent modifier/head annotations across five physical folios
design.related: GDT575/GDT577 modifier-scope history; this freezes a one-head quantitative rival
